job.question: In the SAA investment manager questionnaire for fixed income investment management services, which services is the firm asked to indicate whether it offers, along with any additional fee?
job.expected_facts: Five services: Schedule D investment accounting; asset/liability management (dynamic financial analysis); performance attribution; daily internet access of portfolio information; and SVO filing. For each, the firm marks Yes/No and gives an approximate fee.
job.acceptance: Require all five services; Yes/No and approximate fee wording are useful context, not additional services.

reviews.reason: The document is an SBCERS global custody RFP, not the SAA investment manager questionnaire for fixed income investment management services. It does not contain the requested five-service checklist.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (“SBCERS”)

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, and other services to SBCERS as defined in this RFP.
